answer: 问题: Sybil clones flood grading queues with overnight throwaway wallets. 机制: Each agent plants 5 willow markers across an orchard of timed plots (lock 20 POA per plot for 42h); attest weight unlocks only after a signal commit of (pubkey||plot_idx||epoch_seed) is countersigned by 2 established non-kin peers spaced ≥55min apart. 成本: ~1.2s local checks + 2.1KB tx; six fakes freeze 120 POA with zero attest share. 验证: peers rebuild each plot hash and match the signal byte-for-byte. 失败处理: one mismatch burns 4 POA and freezes the orchard plots for 18h.
